summary.zh: 一段 29 分钟的单打比赛完整录像，DJI 相机放在近端底线后方地面，广角固定机位。近端球员上半段为白红色上衣，约 16:23–17:00 交换场地后为粉色上衣。录像里能看到多个 15–20 秒的长回合、近端球员的大步上网和后场起跳击球。无法从画面确认比分、赛事名称和哪位球员是 Colin。
summary.en: A 29-minute full recording of a singles match from a DJI camera on the floor behind the near baseline (wide angle, fixed). The near-side player wears a white/red shirt until the players change ends at about 16:23-17:00, then a pink shirt. Several 15-20 s rallies, deep forward lunges and jump overheads by the near player are visible. The score, the event and which player is Colin cannot be confirmed from the footage.

subject.who_is_colin: unknown — two candidates: the white/red-shirt player (near side 0:00-16:20, far side after) or the pink-shirt player (far side first, near side from ~17:00)

people_and_privacy.notes: The opponent's face is clearly visible when he walks toward the camera (e.g. 4:21-4:23, 14:48). The umpire and people on neighbouring courts are visible in the background throughout; some look young but are too small to identify. Background chatter picked up by the microphone is not used anywhere.

camera_and_limits: Fixed wide-angle (fisheye-like) camera on the floor behind the near baseline; strong barrel distortion at the edges
Far-side player is small (~60-80 px tall): grip, racket face, contact point and footwork details of the far player are not visible
Near player: body, lunges and jumps visible; racket face, grip and exact contact point mostly not visible from behind
Shuttle is rarely visible in flight, so shot types (smash vs clear vs drop) cannot be confirmed from most frames
Rally boundaries come from automatic motion detection plus visual review of 7 rallies; the other 45 candidates are unverified
Camera clock says 2026-04-04 07:27 local; not confirmed

title.zh: 长回合：后场击球后大步上网
title.en: Long rally: rear-court overheads then a deep lunge forward

key_moments.what_happens: Near player (white/red) plays overheads from the rear court (4:02-4:06), lunges deep toward the front court (4:14) and returns to a wide ready stance (4:19).
Near player (white/red) moves rear-left and rear-right, makes a low lunge at mid-court left (11:22) and an overhead (11:25); rally continues to about 11:31.
Near player (white/red) plays from the rear court (14:37-14:43) and moves forward (14:45-14:47); afterwards he walks to the right sideline where a shuttle lies on the floor (14:50).

title.en: Jump overhead from the rear court

key_moments.what_happens: Near player (pink) leaves the ground for an overhead at the rear left (about 23:11.8), lands in a split/scissor position (23:12.1) and keeps playing until about 23:18.
Near player (pink) jumps for an overhead at about 27:46, then moves forward toward the net (27:49).
Play stops; people stand at the right side of the court (16:23, 16:59). After this the pink-shirt player is on the near side.

technical_observations.observation: White/red near player waits in a wide, low stance in the rear half between shots.
technical_observations.visibility_limits: Seen from behind; weight distribution and split-step timing cannot be measured at 2-3 frames per second.

technical_observations.observation: White/red near player makes long forward lunges toward the front court within long rallies.
technical_observations.visibility_limits: Front foot and knee angle are partly hidden by the body from this angle.

technical_observations.observation: Pink near player leaves the ground on rear-court overheads and lands with a scissor-type leg switch.
technical_observations.visibility_limits: Whether the shot is a smash, clear or drop is not visible; contact height relative to the body is only roughly visible.

technical_observations.observation: After the jump at 23:11.8 the pink player is back in a ready position near mid-court by about 23:13.
technical_observations.visibility_limits: Recovery speed is estimated from sampled frames, not measured.

technical_observations.observation: The far-side player is too small in the frame to judge grip, racket face or foot placement.
technical_observations.visibility_limits: Needs a second camera or a closer, higher position behind the far baseline.

technical_observations.observation: Shot selection and placement cannot be determined because the shuttle is rarely visible in flight.
technical_observations.visibility_limits: A higher camera position (e.g. 2-3 m up behind the baseline) would show the shuttle path.

edit_plan.rationale: Five rallies that were checked frame by frame, each kept whole with ~1 s lead-in, cut right after play stops (no pickup or walking). Slow motion is only a 0.5x repeat of a real moment and is muted. The Short opens on the strongest visual (the jump at 23:11.8) within the first second, then shows the full rally so the slow motion has its real context. For the Short the whole 16:9 frame is kept (zoom 1.35 over a blurred fill) because the players move across the full width and a hard 9:16 crop would cut them out.
